signature: SUBROUTINE DLARFB_GETT( IDENT, M, N, K, T, LDT, A, LDA, B, LDB, WORK, LDWORK )

params.name: ident
params.reference:
If `IDENT` = not 'I', or not 'i', then V1 is unit

-   lower-triangular and stored in the left K-by-K block of
-   the input matrix A,

If `IDENT = 'I'` or 'i', then V1 is an identity matrix and

not stored.

See Further Details section.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix B. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number or rows of the matrix A. K is also order of the matrix T, i.e. the number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the block reflector. $0 \le K \le N$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The upper-triangular K-by-K matrix T in the representation of the block reflector.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge K$.

params.name: A
params.reference:
On entry: a) In the K-by-N upper-trapezoidal part A: input matrix A. b) In the columns below the diagonal: columns of V1

(ones are not stored on the diagonal).

On exit:

A is overwritten by rectangular K-by-N product $H \, A$.

See Further Details section.

params.name: lda
params.reference: `LDB` is INTEGER The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,K)$.

params.name: B
params.reference:
On entry:

-   a) In the M-by-(N-K) right block: input matrix B.
-   b) In the M-by-N left block: columns of V2.

On exit:

B is overwritten by rectangular M-by-N product $H \, B$.

See Further Details section.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: ldwork
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LDWORK} \ge \max (1,K)$.
